source_text: Ὡς οὖν ἀπὸ Ἀβραὰμ ἤρξατο περιτομὴ καὶ ἀπὸ Μωσέως σάββατον καὶ θυσίαι καὶ προσφοραὶ καὶ ἑορταὶ, καὶ ἀπεδείχθη διὰ τὸ σκληροκάρδιον τοῦ λαοῦ ὑμῶν ταῦτα διατετάχθαι, οὕτως παύσασθαι ἔδει κατὰ τὴν τοῦ πατρὸς βουλὴν εἰς τὸν διὰ τῆς ἀπὸ τοῦ γένους τοῦ Ἀδραὰμ καὶ φυλῆς Ἰούδα καὶ Δαυῒδ παρθένου γεννηθέντα υἱὸν τοῦ θεοῦ Χριστόν, ὅστις καὶ αἰώνιος νόμος καὶ καινὴ διαθήκη τῷ παντὶ κόσμῳ ἐκηρύσσετο προελευσόμενος, ὡς αἱ προλελεγμέναι προφητεῖαι σημαίνουσι. Καὶ ἡμεῖς, οἱ διὰ τούτου προσχωρήσαντες τῷ θεῷ, οὐ ταύτην τὴν κατὰ σάρκα παρελάβομεν περιτομήν, ἀλλὰ πνευματικήν , ἣν Ἐνὼχ καὶ οἱ ὅμοιοι ἐφύλαξαν· ἡμεῖς δὲ διὰ τοῦ βαπτίσματος αὐτήν, ἐπειδὴ ἁμαρτωλοὶ ἐγεγόνειμεν, διὰ τὸ ἔλεος τὸ παρὰ τοῦ θεοῦ ἐλάβομεν, καὶ πᾶσιν ἐφετὸν ὁμοίως λαμβάνειν. Περὶ δὲ τοῦ τῆς γενέσεως αὐτοῦ μυστηρίου ἤδη λέγειν κατεπείγοντος λέγω. Ἡσαΐας οὖν περὶ τοῦ γένους αὐτοῦ τοῦ Χριστοῦ, ὅτι ἀνεκδιήγητόν ἐστιν ἀνθρώποις, οὕτως ἔφη ὡς καὶ προγέγραπται· Τὴν γενεὰν αὐτοῦ τίς διηγήσεται; Ὅτι αἴρεται ἀπὸ τῆς γῆς ἡ ζωὴ αὐτοῦ, ἀπὸ τῶν ἀνομιῶν τοῦ λαοῦ μου ἤχθη εἰς θάνατον . Ὡς ἀνεκδιηγήτου οὖν ὄντος τοῦ γένους τούτου ἀποθνήσκειν μέλλοντος, ἵνα τῷ μώλωπι αὐτοῦ ἰαθῶμεν οἱ ἁμαρτωλοὶ ἄνθρωποι, τὸ προφητικὸν πνεῦμα ταῦτα εἶπεν. Ἔτι καὶ ἵνα ὃν τρόπον γέγονεν ἐν κόσμῳ γεννηθεὶς ἐπιγνῶναι ἔχωσιν οἱ πιστεύοντες αὐτῷ ἄνθρωποι, διὰ τοϋ αὐτοῦ Ἡσαίου τὸ προφητικὸν πνεῦμα ὡς μέλλει γίνεσθαι προεφήτευσεν οὕτως· Καὶ προσέθετο κύριος λαλῆσαι τῷ Ἄχαζ, λέγων· Αἴτησον σεαυτῷ σημεῖον παρὰ κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ σου εἰς βάθος ἢ εἰς ὕψος. Καὶ εἶπεν Ἄχαζ· Οὐ μὴ αἰτήσω οὐδ᾿ οὐ μὴ πειράσω κύριον. Καὶ εἶπεν Ἡσαίας· Ἀκούετε δή, οἶκος Δαυΐδ. Μὴ μικρὸν ὑμῖν ἀγῶνα παρέχειν ἀνθρώποις; Καὶ πῶς κυρίῳ παρέχετε ἀγῶνα; Διὰ τοῦτο δώσει κύριος αὐτὸς ὑμῖν σημεῖον· ἰδοὺ ἡ παρθένος ἐν γαστρὶ λήψεται καὶ τέξεται υἱόν, καὶ καλέσεται τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ Ἐμμανουήλ. Βούτυρον καὶ μέλι φάγεται. Πρὶν ἢ γνῶναι αὐτὸν ἢ προελέσθαι πονηρὰ ἐκλέξεται τὸ ἀγαθόν· διότι, πρὶν ἢ γνῶναι τὸ παιδίον ἀγαθὸν ἢ κακόν. ἀπειθεῖ πονηρὰ τοῦ ἐκλέξασθαι τὸ ἀγαθόν. Διότι, πρὶν ἢ γνῶναι τὸ παιδίον καλεῖν πατέρα ἢ μητέρα, λήψεται δύναμιν Δαμασκοῦ καὶ σκύλα Σαμαρείας ἔναντι βασιλέως Ἀσσυρίων. Καὶ καταληφθήσεται ἡ γῆ, ἣν σὺ σκληρῶς οἴσεις ἀπὸ προσώπου τῶν δύο βασιλέων. Ἀλλ᾿ ἐπάξει ὁ θεὸς ἐπὶ σὲ καἰ ἐπὶ τὸν λαόν σου καὶ ἐπὶ τὸν οἶκον τοῦ πατρός σου ἡμέρας. αἳ οὐδέπω ἥκασιν ἐπὶ σέ, ἀπὸ τῆς ἡμέρας ᾗς ἀφεῖλεν Ἐφραῒμ ἀπὸ Ἰούδα τὸν βασιλέα τῶν Ἀσσυρίων [Is., XVII. 10-16a; VIII, 4; VII, 16 b-17]. Ὅτι μὲν οὖν ἐν τῷ γένει τῷ κατὰ σάρκα τοῦ Ἀβραὰμ οὐδεὶς ουδέποτε ἀπὸ παρθένου γεγέννηται οὐδὲ λέλεκται γεγεννημένος ἀλλ᾿ ἢ οὗτος ὁ ἡμέτερος Χριστός, πᾶσι φανερόν ἐστιν. Ἐπεὶ δὲ ὑμεῖς καὶ οἱ διδάσκαλοι ὑμῶν τολμᾶτε λέγειν μηδὲ εἰρῆσθαι ἐν τῇ προφητείᾳ τοῦ Ἡσαΐου Ἰδοὺ ἡ παρθένος ἐν γαστρὶ ἕξει, ἀλλ᾿ Ἰδοὺ ἡ νεᾶνις ἐν γαστρὶ λήψεται καὶ τέξεται υἱόν, καὶ ἐξηγεῖσθε τὴν προφητείαν ὡς εἰς Ἐζεκίαν, τὸν γενόμενον ὑμῶν βασιλέα, πειράσομαι καὶ ἐν τούτῳ καθ᾿ ὑμῶν βραχέα ἐξηγήσασθαι καὶ ἀποδεῖξαι εἰς τοῦτον εἰρῆσθαι τὸν ὁμολογούμενον ὑφ᾿ ἡμῶν Χριστόν.
pass_a_gloss: So then circumcision began from Abraham and the Sabbath and sacrifices and offerings and festivals from Moses, and it was shown because of the hardness of heart of your people that these things were commanded, thus it was necessary for them to cease according to the plan of the Father for the Son of God Christ who was born from the genus of Adam and the tribe of Judah and David through a virgin, who is also the eternal law and the new covenant that was proclaimed to the whole world beforehand, as the prophecies that were spoken beforehand signify. And we, who have come to God through Him, did not receive this circumcision according to the flesh, but a spiritual one, which Enoch and those like him kept; we, however, received it through baptism, since we had become sinners, through the mercy that is from God, and it is available for all to receive equally. Now, concerning the mystery of His birth, I must speak. Isaiah, then, spoke about the genus of Christ, that it is unspeakable to men, and he said, as it is written: 'Who will declare His genus?' 'For His life is taken away from the earth, He was led to death because of the iniquities of my people.' Since, then, the genus of this one who is about to die is unspeakable, so that we sinners may be healed by His wound, the prophetic Spirit said these things. And also, so that people who believe in Him may know how He came into the world, born, the prophetic Spirit prophesied through Isaiah beforehand, saying: 'And the Lord added to speak to Ahaz, saying: Ask for yourself a sign from the Lord your God, either in depth or in height.' And Ahaz said: 'I will not ask, and I will not test the Lord.' And Isaiah said: 'Hear, house of David, will you give little trouble to men? And how do you give trouble to the Lord?' 'Therefore, the Lord Himself will give you a sign: behold, the virgin will conceive in her womb and will bear a son, and His name will be called Emmanuel.' 'He will eat butter and honey before He knows how to choose good or evil.' 'For before the child knows how to call father or mother, He will take the power of Damascus and the spoils of Samaria in the presence of the king of the Assyrians.' 'And the land, which you will possess with difficulty, will be taken away from you, from the presence of the two kings.' 'But God will bring upon you and upon your people and upon the house of your father days that have not yet come upon you, from the day when Ephraim took away the king of the Assyrians from Judah.' For it is clear to all that in the fleshly genus of Abraham no one has ever been born from a virgin, nor has it been said that anyone was born, except this our Christ. Since, however, you and your teachers dare to say that it was not said in the prophecy of Isaiah, 'Behold, the virgin will have in her womb,' but 'Behold, the young woman will conceive in her womb and will bear a son,' and you interpret the prophecy as if it were about Hezekiah, who became your king, I will try to explain briefly and demonstrate against you that it was said about the Christ who is confessed by us.

pass_b_english: Circumcision began with Abraham, and the Sabbath, sacrifices, offerings, and festivals came through Moses; it was shown that these things were commanded because of the hardness of heart of your people. Therefore they had to cease according to the Father's plan, for the sake of the Son of God, Christ, who was born from the race of Adam, the tribe of Judah, and the house of David through a virgin. He is also the eternal law and the new covenant that was proclaimed to the whole world beforehand, as the prophecies spoken earlier signify (Isaiah 53:8). We who have come to God through Him did not receive this circumcision according to the flesh, but a spiritual one, which Enoch and those like him kept. We, however, received it through baptism, since we had become sinners, through the mercy that comes from God, and it is available for all to receive equally.

Now, concerning the mystery of His birth, I must speak. Isaiah spoke about the lineage of Christ, saying that it is unspeakable to men, exactly as it is written: 'Who will declare His generation? For His life is taken away from the earth, and He was led to death because of the iniquities of my people.' Since, then, the lineage of this One who was about to die is unspeakable, so that we sinners may be healed by His wound, the prophetic Spirit said these things (Isaiah 53:8). And also, so that people who believe in Him may know how He came into the world, born, the prophetic Spirit prophesied beforehand through Isaiah, saying: 'And the Lord added to speak to Ahaz, saying: Ask for yourself a sign from the Lord your God, either in depth or in height.' And Ahaz said: 'I will not ask, and I will not test the Lord.' And Isaiah said: 'Hear now, house of David: Is it too little for you to weary men? And how do you weary the Lord? Therefore the Lord Himself will give you a sign: Behold, the virgin will conceive in her womb and bear a son, and His name will be called Emmanuel' (Isaiah 7:14). 'He will eat butter and honey before He knows how to refuse evil and choose good. For before the child knows how to call father or mother, He will take the power of Damascus and the spoils of Samaria in the presence of the king of the Assyrians. And the land which you dread will be forsaken before both her kings. But the Lord will bring upon you and upon your people and upon your father's house days that have not come since the day Ephraim departed from Judah — the king of Assyria' (Isaiah 8:4; Isaiah 7:16-17).

For it is clear to all that in the fleshly lineage of Abraham no one has ever been born from a virgin, nor has it been said that anyone was born, except this our Christ. Since, however, you and your teachers dare to say that it was not said in the prophecy of Isaiah, 'Behold, the virgin will have in her womb,' but 'Behold, the young woman will conceive in her womb and bear a son,' and you interpret the prophecy as if it were about Hezekiah, who became your king, I will try to explain briefly and demonstrate against you that it was said about the Christ whom we confess.
